en: Dependent on a state that is neither without condition nor root, a state that has a condition and is a root arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither without condition nor non-root, a state that has a condition and is not a root arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance. (The conditioned is the same as the "with condition.")
Dependent on a state that is non-visible and non-causal, a state that is non-visible and causal arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible and non-causal, a state that is visible and non-causal arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; one under object; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-reactive, non-root state, a non-reactive root state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-reactive, non-root state, a reactive non-root state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; one under object; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-material, non-root phenomenon, a non-material root phenomenon arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; three for object; one for predominance … pe … one for prenascence and repetition … pe … three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-material, non-non-root phenomenon, a non-material non-root phenomenon arises by way of root condition. (By calculation, three. Abbreviated. Three for root; one for object … pe … three for mutuality … pe … three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither mundane nor non-cause, a supramundane state that is a cause arises by way of root condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is not supramundane and not a cause, a mundane state that is a cause arises by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are two … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are two.
Dependent on a state that is neither mundane nor non-non-cause, a mundane state that is not a cause arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a supramundane, non-causal state, a mundane, non-causal state arises by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are four; under object condition there are two … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are four.

Dependent on a state cognizable by some but not by others and which is non-causal, a state cognizable by some and which is causal arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are nine … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are nine.

Dependent on a state that is not cognizable by anyone and is without root-cause, there arises a state not cognizable by anyone and without root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Nine [instances] for root; ... pe ... nine for non-disappearance.
